lead.hed: Defense News: Army awards $465 million to start high-energy laser production
lead.insight: Defense News, Thursday: the Army awarded AeroVironment $464.8 million this week for the Enduring-High Energy Laser program, meant to shoot down drones at a low cost per shot. The company called it the first production contract for a directed-energy system in U.S. military history. The Other Transaction Agreement covers dozens of 30 kW LOCUST lasers; the Army still has to field them. The still is an August Army file of the E-HEL system at Redstone Arsenal.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Army photo · DVIDS 9906150 · PUBLIC DOMAIN · Enduring-High Energy Laser (E-HEL) system, Redstone Arsenal, Aug. 25, 2026, photo by Darrell Ames. Caption must say August file photo, not today’s contract.
lead.image_note: Official U.S. Army DVIDS still of the E-HEL system — same-subject class as the Army laser production award. Not a brand tile.

political.hed: Defense News: Trump says Europe should repay U.S. Ukraine aid
political.insight: Defense News, Friday: President Trump said Thursday he would ask European nations to pay back the United States for military aid and munitions previously sent to Ukraine. He also wrote that the United States is taking munitions for itself rather than selling them, with allied sales to resume. No repayment schedule has been published.

political.hed: USNI: San Antonio sailors and Marines destroy a second suspected narco refueler
political.insight: USNI News, Thursday: sailors and Marines from USS San Antonio (LPD-17) interdicted and destroyed a second suspected narco logistics vessel in the Eastern Pacific on Wednesday, working with Ecuador as part of Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere. SOUTHCOM’s statement covers this boarding.

political.hed: USNI: Chinese destroyer from the Scarborough collision is back at sea
political.insight: USNI News, Thursday from Manila: Type 052D destroyer Guilin (164), involved in last summer’s fatal collision with a China Coast Guard cutter at Scarborough Shoal, is back in frontline service in the South China Sea according to recent military reports. The item covers the ship’s return, not a new finding on the collision.

tech.hed: OpenAI starts a phased rollout of GPT-6 Astra
tech.insight: OpenAI: GPT-6 Astra is rolling out first to a limited set of organizations, then over coming days to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise, plus the API, Azure, and AWS Bedrock. Benchmark scores are the company’s. Everyday ChatGPT users do not all have it this morning.

tech.hed: Lawmakers want the Army to explain shuttering a specialized drone unit
tech.insight: Defense News, Thursday: a bipartisan group of lawmakers asked the Army why it is closing a specialized drone battalion in the 173rd Airborne less than a year after standing it up. They asked for a written explanation by Sept. 21.

culture.hed: WORLD: Trump signs a stopgap that funds agencies into December
culture.insight: WORLD: President Trump on Wednesday signed a continuing resolution that funds most federal programs at FY2026 levels through December, after the Senate passed it 90-6 in August and the House 370-48 on Tuesday. The White House says it averts an Oct. 1 shutdown. Full-year appropriations are still unfinished.

culture.hed: Law & Liberty: bad publicity can find the quiet neighbors
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Friday: “The Benefits of Bad Publicity” argues that unwanted attention can help people find like-minded neighbors who are quietly reclaiming culture. The piece is cultural argument, not a statute.
